links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease) of chatbot answers to patient questions
links.effect: Readability differed significantly between chatbots (p<.05); DeepSeek-R1 was best and Dental GPT worst. Understandability and actionability did not differ significantly. No readability values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: DeepSeek-R1 performed best, while Dental GPT had the lowest performance in readability.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the performance (accuracy, readability, understandability) of multiple generative LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, ChatGPT-o1, ChatGPT-4, Dental GPT) on simulated patient questions without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
